text:
Jesperi Kotkaniemi had the most talked-about moment of his season on Nov. 22 at Madison Square Garden. HockeyFeed's headline: "Jesperi Kotkaniemi Shocks Everyone And Drills Matt Rempe With A Right Hand." Not what anyone expected from a third overall pick known for his hands of the other kind.

The scoring is a surprise too. He has 5 goals and 11 points in 21 games on 11:34 a night, already past last season's 9 points in 42. Our numbers say it won't last at this rate: those 5 goals came on 1.9 expected (the quality of his shots), he's shooting 25% after 5% last season, and Carolina has scored 7.6 more goals than expected with him on the ice. At five on five the Hurricanes are about six points worse by expected-goal share with him than without.

Still, a bottom-six centre on the reigning Cup winners who's chipping in goals is a nice problem. Carolina has won nine of its last ten games he's played. Enjoy the bounces; just don't price them in.
headline: Kotkaniemi's finishing and his fists
